name: ADA XANES Profile (TAPP-linked)
abstract: Profile for an ADA metadata document describing X-ray absorption near edge structure spectroscopy products generated under a registered xanesTAPP procedure. Adds the XANES analysis detail on the schema:Dataset root and pins prov:used to the xanesTAPP definition, on top of the ADA XANES component-type constraints.
